Without it, (1) the quantified indices in the existing requires clause and both ensures clauses are not well-formed because p, q, r can fall outside [0, |a|); (2) the computed midpoint m = i + (j-i)/2 is not known to satisfy 0 <= m < |a|, so a[m] is an out-of-bounds access; and (3) the decreases measure j-i is not known to be bounded below by 0 when i and j are unconstrained integers.
